name: LinkedIn
summary: Opt out of AI training, hide your connections, and stop profile edit broadcasts.

settings.name: AI Model Training Opt-Out
settings.impact: LinkedIn activated data-for-AI-training in 2025 without explicit opt-in. Your profile, posts, and activity are used to train Microsoft/LinkedIn's generative AI models unless you opt out.
settings.source: Help Net Security: 'LinkedIn now uses your data for AI by default, opt out now!' (2025); Malwarebytes Blog; Proton Blog

settings.name: Search Engine Indexing
settings.impact: A publicly indexed LinkedIn profile gives data brokers, stalkers, and social engineers direct access to your work history, skills, and contact details via any search engine.

settings.name: Profile Edit Broadcasts
clickPath: Share profile updates with your network: Toggle OFF
settings.impact: Every profile update notifies your entire network. This can inadvertently reveal a job search to your current employer.

settings.name: Connections List Visibility
clickPath: Who can see your connections: Only you
settings.impact: Exposing your LinkedIn network allows competitors, recruiters poaching your team, or social engineers to map your professional relationships for targeted attacks.

settings.name: Two-Factor Authentication
settings.impact: LinkedIn has been subject to multiple large-scale credential breaches (2012, 2021). 2FA ensures stolen passwords alone are insufficient for account access.
